value.rationale: The classical no-consecutive-index Zeckendorf legality constraint applied to historically motivated centered nonagonal numbers yields a natural exact eventual coverage invariant. The sharp cutoff 9083 strictly extends the known information 2648 for unrestricted distinct centered nonagonal sums. The result is a natural finite-to-infinite classification of this precise restricted additive system; it is not just a numerical sample.
